title: Velocity at detachment
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the ball's speed at point A using energy conservation from the given spring energy.

title: Energy conservation to C
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy between points A and C, accounting for the change in gravitational potential energy.

title: Minimum speed at C
description: Important: States or uses the condition for circular motion at the top (N ≥ 0) to find the minimum required speed.

title: Normal force at C
description: Essential: Correctly applies Newton's second law for circular motion at point C to find the normal force from the track.

title: Pressure and motion after C
description: Essential: Correctly states the pressure (magnitude and direction) on the track and describes the subsequent projectile motion.

title: Sign error in energy
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the gravitational potential energy term when applying energy conservation between A and C.

title: Forgetting normal force direction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the normal force in the force balance at point C (e.g., mg - N = mv²/R).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis for key calculations (energy, force) to verify dimensional consistency.
